reviews.author: Sam Clark
reviews.text: I had storm damage to the ridge cap of my garage and called Don to see if he could do the repair. He came out one day after I called and did the repair, and then some, in short order. He is a very nice man to work with and I highly recommend his services to anyone who needs roofing repair or any roofing work done. It is refreshing to know that there are still honest, hard working people left in the construction business. Thank you for your help, Don.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: Don Tolley just finished our roof on Friday (04/14/2017). GREAT WORKMANSHIP. Very Professional. My wife and I are Very,Very Pleased with the Quality of our roof replacement. We would RECOMMEND Don to anyone that needs a new roof !!! THANKS AGAIN, DON

reviews.author: Arlene Tolley
reviews.text: My roof is 20 months old and it already needs a $650 repair. I was also told the roof is not up to code. If I could give zero stars, I would.
